```{r Chapter 1 Example}
# vote share base on economic growth
data(hibbs)
plot(hibbs$growth, hibbs$vote, xlab="Average Recent Growth in Personal Income", ylab = "Incumbent Party's Vote Share")

M1 <- stan_glm(vote ~ growth, data = hibbs)

abline(coef(M1), col="blue")

print(M1)

#comparing LM to Stan_glm
M2 <- lm(vote ~ growth, data = hibbs)

abline(coef(M2), col="red")

stargazer(M2, type = "text")
```


```{r Practicing with MN Election Data}
X1992 <- read_excel("Election Data/1992_results.xls")
plot(X1992$PresDFL/X1992$Ballots, X1992$Ballots)
ggplot(X1992, aes(PresDFL/Ballots, EDR/Ballots)) + geom_point() + geom_abline() + labs(x = "Percentage of Vote For DFL Candidate", y = "Percentage of Voters that Registered Same Day", title = 'Percentage of Votes for DFL Candidate by Precinct')
```
